name: 整列頁首＋標誌左、兩列導覽靠右、貼邊主要按鈕，捲動後變矮並只留導覽
desc: 固定在頂端的整列頁首：右側上方一列次要列、下方一列導覽連結，最右側一顆撐滿頁首高度並貼齊畫面右緣的主要按鈕；捲動後變矮，標誌與次要列隱藏，導覽連結置中。
prompt: 建立一個橫跨整個畫面寬的頁首列，固定在畫面頂端：標誌在左，導覽連結與功能區靠右，內容延伸到畫面左右邊緣，比頁面內容寬度更寬。標誌在頁首內垂直置中，右側可放一個較小的附屬標誌，沒有時省略。導覽連結上方一定有一列次要列，和導覽連結一樣靠右對齊，放一組小型文字連結，各組連結之間有直向分隔線；次要列最右側可再放一個小型輸入框，沒有時省略。導覽連結的文字明顯比次要列大。功能區固定是一個主要按鈕，放在最右側，高度等於整個頁首高，貼齊頁首的上緣、下緣與畫面右緣，按鈕內圖示在上、文字在下。目前所在的導覽項目下方有一條短底線，貼齊頁首下緣。捲動後頁首高度變矮，排列也改變：標誌與次要列隱藏，導覽連結排成一列並在畫面水平置中，主要按鈕留在最右側，仍貼齊頁首上緣、下緣與畫面右緣。
mobile: 頁首上只留標誌在左、選單按鈕在右；選單按鈕是一個方形區塊，貼齊頁首上緣、下緣與畫面右緣，按鈕內圖示在上、短文字在下。導覽連結、次要列與主要按鈕都收進選單面板：點選單按鈕後，展開蓋住整個畫面的選單面板，導覽連結直向排列。捲動後的行為未經確認，先保留固定在畫面頂端、取消變矮與排列改變。

en.name: Header bar with logo left, two-row navigation on the right and a flush primary button; shrinks to navigation only on scroll
en.desc: A full-width header bar fixed to the top: on the right, a secondary row sits above the row of navigation links, and a primary button at the far right fills the header height flush with the right edge of the viewport; after scrolling the header gets shorter, the logo and secondary row are hidden and the navigation links are centered.
en.prompt: Create a header bar spanning the full width of the viewport, fixed to the top of the viewport, with the logo on the left, with the navigation links and the actions group on the right; the content extends to the left and right edges of the viewport, wider than the page content width. The logo is vertically centered in the header; optionally place a smaller secondary logo to its right; omit it when there is no content. Above the navigation links there is always a secondary row, right-aligned like the navigation links, holding a group of small text links with vertical dividers between the groups of links; optionally place one small input field at the right end of the secondary row; omit it when there is no content. The navigation link text is clearly larger than the secondary row. The actions group is always one primary button at the far right, as tall as the whole header, flush with the top and bottom edges of the header and the right edge of the viewport, with an icon above its text. The current navigation item has a short underline beneath it, flush with the bottom edge of the header. After scrolling, the header gets shorter and its arrangement changes: the logo and the secondary row are hidden, the navigation links form a single row centered horizontally in the viewport, and the primary button stays at the far right, still flush with the top and bottom edges of the header and the right edge of the viewport.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the mobile layout.
en.mobile: Only the logo on the left and a menu button on the right stay in the header; the menu button is a square block flush with the top and bottom edges of the header and the right edge of the viewport, with an icon above a short text. The navigation links, the secondary row and the primary button all move into the menu panel: tapping the menu button opens a menu panel covering the whole viewport, with the navigation links stacked vertically. The behavior after scrolling is unconfirmed; for now the header stays fixed to the top of the viewport, without shrinking or changing its arrangement.
